workstream: Stage 3 workstream 3.7 (ADR 0013 section 7, MOA floor measurement)
postHoc: DECLARED POST-HOC ADDENDUM: designed after the primary run (cases.json) showed no case spending the deadline; calibrated by production Precise Optimize (results/calibration.json), frozen before this addendum ran; reported separately from the primary denominators.

policy.note: Production constants, not chosen here: default budget 30000 ms (DEFAULT_FLOOR_TIME_LIMIT_MS), at most 14 threshold trials (MOA_FLOOR_MAX_TRIALS), bracket tolerance 0.02 MOA, native stop mip_max_improving_sols=1, Precise. bench.ts asserts them at run time.

cacheStateDefinition.cold: first floor request of a fresh node process: no HiGHS instance, no blueprint memo, no compatibility map (the item lookup is built from the snapshot before the request is sent, as a loaded IndexedDB/JSON data set would be)
cacheStateDefinition.warm: the identical request sent again to the same worker runtime right after the cold one finished: HiGHS instantiated, blueprint memoized on the same lookup, compatibility map cached; no result cache exists for floors

plan.denominatorRule: every planned request counts in every rate, including errors, crashes and missing results

cases.intent: edge-feasible: budget 100,000 RUB and minimum ergonomics 93 = the certified maximum ergonomics under that budget (only ergonomics-optimal builds are witnesses)
infeasible: budget 100,000 RUB and minimum ergonomics 93.05, just above the certified maximum 93; the seed must prove emptiness or spend the deadline
edge-feasible: budget 60,000 RUB and minimum ergonomics 85.6 = the certified maximum ergonomics under that budget
infeasible: budget 60,000 RUB and minimum ergonomics 85.65, just above the certified maximum 85.6
